portalOpenFuture.js: const t = Date.now()/300; const s = 1 + Math.sin(t)*0.08; ctx.scale(s, s); ctx.globalAlpha = 0.7 + Math.sin(t*3)*0.3;

portalOpenParallel.js: const t = Date.now()/600; ctx.rotate(Math.sin(t)*0.15); ctx.globalAlpha = 0.65 + Math.sin(t*2.5)*0.35;

cellFilled.js: const t = Date.now()/400; ctx.globalAlpha = 0.75 + Math.sin(t*4)*0.25; const s = 1 + Math.sin(t*2)*0.1; ctx.scale(s, s);

figureDiamond.js: const t = Date.now()/500; ctx.scale(1 + Math.sin(t)*0.05, 1 - Math.sin(t)*0.05);

figureSquare.js: const t = Date.now()/120; ctx.translate(Math.sin(t*3)*0.6, Math.cos(t*2.7)*0.6); ctx.rotate(Math.sin(t*1.5)*0.03);

figurePolyhedron.js: const t = Date.now()/1100; ctx.scale(1 + Math.sin(t*1.8)*0.08, 1 - Math.sin(t*1.8)*0.08);
